verdict.rationale: Ad-hoc grouping and filtering on high-cardinality fields is a fair question for an observability platform like Datadog. The evidence pack does not show it. The Log Management and APM entries are titles only and say nothing about querying high-cardinality fields without pre-aggregation or indexing. The one community comment (comm-13) describes clicking a field to make it a custom search dimension, which is an explicit definition step rather than querying without one, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group and filter by high-cardinality fields (user id, request id) without pre-aggregating or defining indexes first
